title: Rule
description: A rule fragment. Markdown body with optional frontmatter. Compiled to AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/.cursorrules etc.

id.description: Stable identifier; usually the source filename without extension.

targets.description: If set, only emit to these adapter ids.

excludes.description: If set, do not emit to these adapter ids.

concat.description: Whether this rule is concatenated with siblings into one rules file (true) or kept as a separate file when the target supports it (false).

order.description: Sort key for concatenation order. Lower values appear first.

description.description: Human-readable purpose; surfaced in dialect frontmatter (.mdc description, Windsurf/Continue description).

globs.description: Canonical activation globs, adapter-mapped per dialect (.mdc globs, .instructions.md applyTo, .clinerules paths:).

activation.description: When the rule applies — the convergent cross-dialect vocabulary (Windsurf trigger, Cline/Continue modes, Cursor rule types).

alwaysApply.description: Cursor-dialect always flag (.mdc alwaysApply); false with globs = glob activation.

dir.description: Subtree placement: compile into this directory's nested AGENTS.md instead of the root.
